channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump: Putin offered to help settle Iranian nuclear enrichment impasse
item.description: Donald Trump said that Vladimir Putin told him he’d “like to be involved” in settling Iranian nuclear enrichment.

item.title: US lawmakers question Pete Hegseth over budget for war on Iran
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth testified before Congress on the Pentagon’s budget for the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Pentagon chief Hegseth first public hearing on Iran war: Key takeaways
item.description: Pete Hegseth testifies alongside General Dan Caine, responds to questions on war Pentagon says has cost $25bn.

item.title: CCTV footage shows moment Israeli strike targets Palestinians
item.description: Surveillance cameras captured the moment an Israeli strike hit a group of Palestinians in Gaza City on Friday.

item.title: Trump vows to maintain Iran blockade, Tehran threatens ‘practical’ action
item.description: US president says Washington's naval siege on Iranian ports is 'more effective than the bombing' as oil price soars.

item.title: Oil price rises above $120 after reports of 'extended' Iran blockade
item.description: The price of crude oil has swung sharply as uncertainty over the war in the Middle East continues.

item.title: Former US officials criticise Pentagon silence on deadly Iran school attack
item.description: In the two months since the deadly strike, the US defence department has said only that the incident is under investigation.

item.title: Israeli 'double-tap' strike kills three rescue workers in Lebanon, officials say
item.description: They are among nine people killed in successive attacks on Tuesday, which Israel's military says targeted a Hezbollah commander.

item.title: Four key takeaways from Jerome Powell's final rate decision as Fed chair
item.description: Powell's news conference after holding rates covered the US-Israel war with Iran, inflation, legal attacks, and the Fed's independence.

item.title: A faraway conflict threatens livelihoods in India's glass hub
item.description: Supply disruptions due to Middle East tensions have pushed up costs in India’s glass industry, putting workers at risk.
